name: hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r4s
slot_change_request: quant_NW_xp_ctl: master ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl_r3 -> ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl_r4 (rl_cfg 6 -> 7 bits, RLI 2..126 / WCI 2..63; ties RLI = RL+4+2*XR, WCI = WC+2+XR from the soft parent ot_hgi_qdq_host_split_r3); outline 108 x 108 -> 108 x 129.6 um (two ring SRAMs, 20 um macro channels on all-pin faces) -> HBM-DIE12 (NOTICE).

job.purpose: Deep strap QUANT transport controller for the d4g split r3: GEN2e4 r11 needs RL 54 at hb_quant_NW (RLI 58+2XR), ctl_r3 takes RLI <= 46. Command metadata ring in one 128x64 1R1W SRAM. Bench = split r3 lockstep vs the monolith at L 7 / 54, XR 0 / 12.

benches.name: QDQ_SPLIT_R3_mutant_ring_late
benches.why: ctl_r4 ring read address one entry late (MUT 3): rsel / dst / header one command off

benches.name: QDQ_SPLIT_R3_mutant_unpriced_relay
benches.why: L 54, 12 relay stages present, straps priced for 11

structural_change: ctl r4: ctl_r3 (strap latency, pin capture registers, reset relay, closed TT +127.80 / FF +14.92) with the 46-bit command metadata pipeline sp/dp/hp moved from a 48-deep flop shift register into a 128-entry ring in one ot_sram_1r1w_128x64_m1_p192 (write every edge at wp, read at wp+1-RLI; rd = tap NP-3, two flop stages = tap NP-1); vp/lp stay reset flops. Gate 1 native census FAIL (strap tap muxes 167-220 loads per strap flop, reset 475, bank bases 33-70) -> r4b: NO taps: vp/lp also in ring A, commit pipeline donep/lastp in ring B (ot_sram_1r1w_64x16_m1), reset-edge counter masks pre-release entries, kept per-bank 3-bit base copies, 4 ot_rst_relay leaves. RLI 2..126 covers the GEN2e4 need RL 54 (RLI 58 + 2*XR). Gate 2 (spine): census PASS max 27, spread 34.9/29.8; reset_landing FAIL (relay put 6 flops on rst_n) -> 2-flop face landing + 4 kept leaves.

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every pin already (ctl_r4 captures (as ctl_r3) every cmd_* and strap bit at its pin, rr_v/vo/qfault/decode_fault enter flops, every output is a register, rst_n drives only the 3-flop relay): ctl_r2 with the same boundary is native PASS (launch 181.2, capture 138.1, 0 comb). Extra tool pin registers would add edges the split r2 lockstep does not price.

clock_note: fallback variant: macro-avoiding equal-delay clock spine (common_flow/clock_spine.tcl), as nw48 gate c (spread 28.7/21.8)
